  Scenario: AC11 A case action commits only after its entry is written, and the case side holds no ledger row (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock returns one entry reference with case_seq 7 for event "CONTACT"
    When the case owner records a call on case "RW-2026-000201" and repeats it with the same Idempotency-Key

  Scenario: AC12 A timed-out append is refused, and a retry after the commit returns the stored entry (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock does not answer inside 2 s for the first append of case "RW-2026-000201", and the first call had committed at the owner with case_seq 7
    When the case owner records a call on case "RW-2026-000201" and the same action is retried with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the first call is refused with status 503 and MSG-P1-022, and its link row is "REFUSED"
    Then the retry returns the stored entry with case_seq 7 and the action commits once
    Then one entry exists for the action
